versions.changelog:
Initial release of parent-teacher-prep – helps parents get the most out of K-12 conferences.

- Builds a structured pre-conference dossier (grades, attendance, work samples, parent observations)
- Generates an age-appropriate, information-focused question bank across key areas (academics, social, behavior, home support)
- Decodes teacher jargon into plain language with follow-up prompts for clarity
- Converts conference notes into a practical 24-hour/1-week action plan and a follow-up confirmation email draft
- Designed for use before, during, and after any parent-teacher conference or school progress meeting
